description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.
The list of API security event IDs.
The dimension of the security event.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-apisec-events --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-g4t00000 --event-ids eb370fb29781f75c07cabd5b200000 --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --event-scope ip --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DeleteApisecEvents --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --EventIds.1 eb370fb29781f75c07cabd5b200000 --InstanceId 'waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-g4t00000' --ClusterId 428 --EventScope ip --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
